annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委办公厅 等六部门办公厅 (National Health Commission General Office with Ministry of Education, SAMR, General Administration of Sport, CYLC, All-China Women's Federation)
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets a 70% reduction in annual growth of child overweight/obesity rates in 2020-2030, with 80/70/60% by high/medium/low prevalence regions.
Assigns responsibilities to families, schools, health institutions and government.
Requires minimum school physical activity time and improved school meal provision.
Strengthens food marketing and labelling controls for high-sugar, fat and salt foods aimed at children.
Requires monitoring and evaluation led by the National Health Commission.
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry notice circulating the Implementation Plan for Prevention and Control of Obesity among Children and Adolescents. It sets 2020-2030 targets to reduce growth in overweight and obesity rates and assigns tasks to families, schools, health institutions and government. It has no AI or robotics content.
